newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty lifted by money-market cash shortage.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty lifted by money-market cash shortage.

text.p: The Polish zloty strengthened against the currency basket as banks shortened their foreign currency positions to take advantage of surging deposit rates on the money market, dealers said.

Overnight rates hovered just below the lombard rate of 25 percent for most of Monday as the market remained severely short of cash after banks had overinvested in high-yielding NBP-bills earlier in the month.
"As long as the situation on the money market persists, the zloty will probably be under upward pressure," said Bogdan Stepkowski, senior forex dealer at ING bank in Warsaw.
